notes.title: Important Update: Workaround Solution for Windows 11 Auto-Closing Issue
notes.content:
"Dear Players,

We're reaching out to address a known issue affecting players who are using Windows 11. Some of you have reported that the game auto-closes approximately 60 seconds after launching. This is a recognized compatibility issue prevalent in many Unreal Engine projects, stemming from incompatibilities between Windows 11 and Unreal Engine's libcurl 7.47.1.

Solution / Workaround:

To resolve this issue, we recommend the following steps:

Navigate to the following path on your computer:
C:\Users\\AppData\Local\TimelessParadoxVR\Saved\Config\WindowsNoEditor\Engine.ini

Add the following two lines to the end of the Engine.ini file:

[Networking]
UseLibCurl=false

This modification will disable the use of LibCurl, solving the compatibility issues with Windows 11 and older Unreal Engine games.

Thank you for your continued support, and if you have any further issues or questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.

We're also putting our hearts and souls into developing our second title, 'Timeless Heart VR.' The adventure continues, and we're eager to reconnect with you all in this new and immersive VR experience. Stay tuned for more updates — we're excited to share this journey with you very soon!

Best regards,
John

notes.title: Minor Text corrections
notes.content:
Dear players,

Thanks to my Japanese friends’ suggestions. 
Three Japanese text errors were corrected in this update.

1.	誰か失敗した⇒誰が失敗した
2.	防御がしなさい時⇒防御がしない時
3.	フォーカス矢印⇒フォーカスの矢

Many thanks
Enjoy the game

Best regards
John

notes.title: HotFix
notes.content:
Dear players,
I am glad that so far there is no feedback regarding to game crashing,
But during my daily testing today, I found one issue that might cause the crash.
And this issue is addressed in this update.
Also, many players messaged me that the original dark knight difficulty is quite balanced.
So, I roll back one setting, that only true blades can destroy his armor.
Then this level difficulty will be slightly increased.
But I also kept the sword skill damage to the boss, 
Players can still pass this boss without counter and chain attack.

Best regards
John

notes.title: HotFix
notes.content:

Many thanks for reporting this issue.
Best regards
John
